read.en: SpaceX fell 9.1% on Oct 22 to $144.75, trading between $143.21 and $154.22 on twice its average volume, with no 100-day average yet (92 sessions). It is below the falling 5-day ($149.2), 10-day ($152.9) and 30-day ($153.5) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 but is above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($169.40), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: SpaceX 10月22日下跌 9.1%，收于 $144.75，盘中区间 $143.21–154.22，成交量约为平均水平的两倍；上市仅 92 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$149.2）、10 日（$152.9）和 30 日均线（$153.5）下方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方，但仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$169.40），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The drop erased the Oct 21 jump, breaking the $158 and $154 supports and the $145.4 Sep 28 low, all now resistance. Resistance is $145.4–147.1, then $149.2–149.8 (5-day, Aug 17 high) and $153–154.2 (10 and 30-day). Support is $142.9–143.2, then $140.7 (Oct 15 low) and $130.4 (Aug 20 low). A close below $140.7 would open $130.4; a close above $147.1 would target $149–154.

r.en: Sep 28 low $145.4; Jun 23 low $147.1, now resistance
